# Trimming into Strength

Report 032 | Published 2020-09-09 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2020-9-9/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/032.json)

Nvidia valuation motivates a small defensive shift.

The note is an allocation decision rather than a quantified market forecast. The NVIDIA sale carries a major observed opportunity cost over transparent later windows; that should remain visible without pretending those windows were the author's prediction horizon.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

The stated action cut exposure, but subsequent one- and five-year sensitivities reveal substantial foregone gains versus SPY. No reentry rule or expected holding horizon was specified, so this is strong adverse opportunity-cost evidence rather than a fabricated dated forecast failure.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [NVIDIA sale opportunity-cost sensitivities](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

Next close September 10, 2020 to September 9, 2021: NVDA adjusted-close +80.32% versus SPY+36.47%; to September 9, 2025: NVDA+1291.12% versus SPY+109.18%. Vendor split/dividend proxy, no costs; one/five-year windows are evaluator-defined.
